text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) begins. One of the 
runners, Matikane Tannhauser, was a 
delightfully "ordinary" Umamusume whose 
slight clumsiness made her easy to love.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Brian saw through to the 
inner strength of the girl declaring "I 
won't lose!" And replied, "I'll answer you 
with everything I've got."
